headwords: bói ra ma, quét nhà ra rác

flags.why: The example says the content is unchanged, contradicting the idiom's meaning of old form with new content ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/binh-cu-ruou-moi-eDyWWwpqFsddC.html)).
flags.fix: Cuốn sách này là bình cũ rượu mới: hình thức vẫn như trước nhưng nội dung đã đổi mới.

flags.why: “Old wine in a new bottle” reverses the Vietnamese idiom's old form and new content.
flags.fix: This book is new wine in an old bottle: its form remains the same, but its content has been renewed.

flags.why: The entry omits the familiar sweet street snack made with coconut, maltose candy and sesame, commonly sold in northern Vietnam ([VTC News](https://vtcnews.vn/vi-sao-goi-la-mon-bo-bia-ma-khong-co-thit-bo-ar906894.html)).
flags.fix: sweet rice-paper roll filled with shredded coconut, maltose candy and sesame seeds
